messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning a cross-region fallback drill next Tue 09:00 PT to validate model-registry + auth-provider fallbacks after last week's outage. Need owners and a short test plan. Who can take lead?

aj: I can lead the drill. I'll coordinate infra + SecOps and run vendor escalation dry-run. Will need the runbook refreshed before hand.

sam: Assign infra network pieces to me. I'll prep route table failover, test LB weights, and validate S3/replication. Will update the checklist with exact test commands.

lee: I'll own model-registry fallback: create a snapshot restore flow, warm local cache, and exercise endpoint aliasing so consumers failover to read-only config. I'll add a canary script.

oliver: I'll take auth provider tests — rotate tokens, simulate provider latency and issuer downtime, and verify HSM/KMS fallback path. Also will confirm our token TTL fallbacks are wired into the agent.

maria: Nice. High-level acceptance criteria (short):
- app traffic can route to alt-region model endpoints within 60s :hourglass_flowing_sand:
- no PII leaked during replication failover :lock:
- token renewal path works when main auth issuer returns 500s
- post-drill postmortem + action items logged within 48h

aj: Action items I have so far:
- Runbook refresh & DR checklist (owner: aj) — due Mon 17:00 PT
- Vendor escalation dry-run (owner: aj) — on drill day, 09:30 PT

sam: Infra tasks:
- Route table failover script + smoke tests (owner: sam) — due Mon 12:00 PT
- Canary LB config to simulate cross-region failover (owner: sam) — due Mon 15:00 PT

lee: Model-registry tasks:
- Snapshot/restore doc + test harness (owner: lee) — due Mon 14:00 PT
- Canary script: will push a small model and verify reads from fallback endpoint (owner: lee) — due Mon 18:00 PT

oliver: Auth tasks:
- Simulate issuer 500s + assert fallback path (owner: oliver) — due Mon 16:00 PT
- HSM path smoke test (owner: oliver) — due Mon 16:30 PT

maria: Quick smoke test commands I'll add to the runbook (putting them here so CI can be copied):
```
# smoke tests
curl -sS https://staging.api.redwood/models/health | jq .status
python ./tools/smoke_test.py --model-registry fallback --simulate-auth-failure
```

lee: Quick canary snippet for aliasing (will put in PR):
```
{
  "canary": true,
  "route_policy": "percent:5->alt-region,95->primary",
  "checks": ["/health","/model/1/predict"]
}
```

aj: oncall-bot — please schedule a calendar event and page the drill channel 15m before start.

oncall-bot: Scheduled: Cross-region fallback drill — Tue 09:00 PT. Reminder set 15m prior. PagerDuty test payloads enabled.

maria: OK — final ask: every owner please drop a 1-line status in this thread when your item is done. We'll run the drill, collect logs, and aim for a short postmortem within 48h. If you see any recurring pattern items (model-registry auth + cloud region) — call them out in the postmortem so we can escalate to product/vendor. :white_check_mark:

sam: Will do. I'll post the rig test results here once route failover smoke passes.

lee: Added PR for canary scripts and README. Marking my items as in-progress.

oliver: Auth tests queued in CI — will post results after run.

aj: Runbook updated, link in the incidents board. See you Tue. :calendar:
